data.revised_prompt: Stylized concept art of a single centered floating AI mascot named Mofei, designed as an Android mascot revision. Follow the visual logic of a compact horizontal oval thin blown-crystal glass pod, approximately 1.25:1 wide-to-high, with an almost invisible clear shell and only faint icy-blue glass edge refraction. The viewer must clearly see through the shell into a luminous deep-blue inner space. In the center floats a small recessed rounded-square blue optical face panel, much smaller than the body, with no mouth and two vertical white-blue luminous eyes; it should read as a small optical panel, not a black monitor. On each side of the pod, include a detached short open C-shaped transparent focus-frame bracket, like elegant camera scan brackets, not headphones, not gears, not earcups. Add a single very thin glowing orbit ribbon crossing diagonally around the lower outer shell, like a floating orbital path, not a thick ring beneath it. No arms, no legs, no base. The shape should feel like a delicate glass spacecraft companion, not a robot head or toy. Make the status colors visible only as luminous internal light and orbit color variations: ice blue, cyan, violet, amber, orange, coral red, mint white. Premium Apple-like liquid glass material, crisp transparency, subtle caustics, thin pearlescent rim highlights, airy floating shadow, white-blue studio background. Composition: a single centered full character with a small restrained arc of seven abstract colored glow indicators. Avoid milky plastic shell, vinyl toy, chrome, thick opaque body, dark rectangular screen, headphone parts, cog wheels, oversized ring, text, labels, logos, watermark, UI panels, diagrams, humans, scenery.
